# scripts/PlayerUtils/ObstacleProfile.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/PlayerUtils/ObstacleProfile.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Traversal measurements; positions are world-space, height is feet-relative.
Unmeasured thickness and absent far-floor drop use INF.

Base: `RefCounted`. Registered class: `none`.
